props.gloss_en: the mishna: one who carries out rope [is liable for] enough to make an ear [handle] for a basket
the mishna: reed grass -- enough to make a loop for a sifter or a sieve
the baraita: hard palm leaves -- enough to make an ear for an Egyptian wicker basket
Acherim: bast -- enough to put on the mouth of a small funnel to strain the wine
the baraita: fat -- enough to smear under a small cake
the baraita: and how much is its measure? as a sela
a baraita: [the measure of fat is] as a dried fig
the stam: this [a sela] and that [a dried fig] are one measure
the baraita: soft stuffing -- enough to make a small ball
the baraita: and how much is its measure? as a nut

objections.gloss_en: חבל נמי ליחייב כדי לעשות תלאי לנפה ולכברה -- rope too should make one liable at the measure of a loop for a sifter or a sieve [as reed grass does]

answered_by.gloss_en: כיון דחריק במנא לא עבדי אינשי -- since it cuts into the vessel, people do not make [such a loop of rope]

objections.gloss_en: והתניא כגרוגרת -- but a baraita teaches [the measure of fat is] a dried fig!

answered_by.gloss_en: אידי ואידי חד שיעורא הוא -- this and that are one measure (= p_sela_grogeret_chad_shiura)
